source_fingerprint.algorithm: sha256(path + NUL + file bytes + NUL, sorted source paths)
source_fingerprint.scope: Cargo.toml/lock, src, crates, assets, os scripts/helpers/config/systemd/tests; no generated evidence/docs/builds

scope: Debian software/component CI. Actual initrd build and image backend checks have separate local evidence; CI does not rebuild that initrd or certify a live ISO/install/reboot.
